name: agent-brain
description: Per-project memory for Claude Code: a size-capped STATE.md snapshot and a local card board kept in <project>/.agent-brain, loaded at every session start; /handoff and /onboard-project skills; always-on Karpathy coding guidelines and rule books; MCP servers for Jira (on-prem + portfolio), Redmine and Nexus.

jira_url.title: Jira base URL
jira_url.description: Jira Server/Data Center base URL, e.g. https://jira.example.internal (used by jira-onprem and jira-portfolio)

jira_token.title: Jira personal access token
jira_token.description: Jira PAT (Bearer). Stored in the OS keychain.

redmine_api_key.title: Redmine API key
redmine_api_key.description: Redmine REST API key (My account > API access key). Stored in the OS keychain.

nexus_url.title: Nexus base URL
nexus_url.description: Sonatype Nexus Repository base URL, e.g. https://nexus.example.internal

nexus_password.title: Nexus password
nexus_password.description: Nexus password for basic auth. Stored in the OS keychain.
